limits: Research reviews are AI-assisted discovery and synthesis, with original citation markers and access limitations retained; their claims are not silently admitted as new map occupations.
Page editorial summaries use separately checked official and primary sources; place pages and culture histories remain distinct.
Both road maps use source-qualified geographic anchors and schematic connections, not surveyed route polylines or a claim of complete synchronous road networks.
The NOAA significant earthquake catalog is selective. Epicenters do not encode damage footprints or establish impacts on nearby settlements.
The collection is an initial regional batch; the next complex research queue is explicit. No 3D model is included.
